candidateProvenance: Two independently generated live with-skill answers archived before tuning, reused without new candidate calls. Neither answer is a calibration label.
weighting: one vote per deterministic check and semantic criterion

remainingDeterministicFailure.finding: The original regex rejects an answer starting with No, don't do it now, despite the semantic judge accepting the full recommendation, rationale and concrete future-refactor conditions. The regex and archived deterministic result were intentionally not changed.

reportedJudgeCost.meaning: Runtime-reported list-price estimate, not an additional subscription charge.

cliExitMeaning: Scoring completed with valid assessments; one trace retains an original quality-check failure. This is not invalid execution.
limitations: One with-skill answer per case, without a without-skill arm, cannot measure skill lift.
This verifies the installed consumer's live archive-to-calibrated-score path on two covered policies, not general judge reliability.
Original deterministic scores, receipts, traces, policy and skill snapshots are unchanged; only separate assessment artifacts were added.
The full candidate and assessment archives remain local and ignored.
